criteria.statement: NIP-86 relay administration is opt-in and disabled by default with no configured targets.

Enabled config requires an administrator private-key secret reference, explicit Bahia-owned or Bahia-authorized targets, secure wss/https relay administration URLs except localhost/loopback development targets, and administrator pubkeys.
The NIP-86 client refuses unconfigured targets, targets that do not authorize the signing administrator pubkey, and external plaintext ws/http administration endpoints.
Every NIP-86 HTTP request uses application/nostr+json+rpc and NIP-98 kind 27235 authorization with method=POST, u=relay URL, and a payload tag bound to the exact JSON request body.
The client only permits NIP-86 relay-owner administration methods and rejects ContextVM/app/control-plane mutation method names before HTTP I/O.
HTTP status failures and relay JSON errors are surfaced explicitly.
